configuration.title: Agent CodeWalk
configuration.storagePath.description: Override the local Agent CodeWalk data directory. AGENT_CODEWALK_HOME takes precedence.
configuration.companionPath.description: Override the bundled MCP companion executable used during integration setup.
configuration.refreshInterval.descriptio: Fallback poll interval in milliseconds. New walkthroughs are normally detected by watching the data directory; this poll covers filesystems where watching does not work.
configuration.notifyOnPublish.descriptio: Show a notification when an agent publishes a new walkthrough.
command.expandAll.title: Expand All Steps
command.collapseAll.title: Collapse All Steps
command.toggleStep.title: Expand or Collapse Walkthrough Step
configuration.initialDepth.description: How many levels of a nested walkthrough are open when it is first shown. Deeper steps stay one click away.
configuration.trigger.description: When an agent should produce a walkthrough. Changing this takes effect for new agent sessions; restart an active one to apply it there.
configuration.trigger.auto: Automatic: the agent records a baseline before its first edit and publishes a walkthrough once it has verified the work.
configuration.trigger.manual: On request: the agent publishes a walkthrough only when you ask for one. Asking it to explain existing code still works, because that is already a request.
